bed.exampleZh: 我整理好床铺，然后去厨房吃早饭。

bike.example: I ride my bike to school every day because it is fast and fun.

body.exampleZh: 健康的身体需要好的食物、足够的水和每天规律锻炼。

boring.exampleZh: 那场漫长的会议太无聊了，我差点睡着了。

born.example: The baby was born in a small hospital near our home last night.
born.exampleZh: 这个婴儿昨晚在我们家附近的一家小医院出生。

borrow.example: I need to borrow a book from the library today.
borrow.exampleZh: 我今天需要从图书馆借一本书。

both.example: Both of my parents like to walk in the park.

breakfast.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前和家人一起吃早餐。

cake.exampleZh: 我妈妈为我的生日做了一个巧克力蛋糕。

camera.exampleZh: 我昨天买了一台新照相机，和朋友们拍了很多照片。

cause.exampleZh: 恶劣天气会给开车出行的人带来许多问题。

choice.example: You have a choice between the red book and the blue one.

dentist.exampleZh: 我昨天去看牙医，因为我的牙很痛。

desk.example: I put my books and a small lamp on the desk before studying.
desk.exampleZh: 我在学习前把书和一盏小台灯放在书桌上。

die.example: His old dog died quietly in the garden last night.
die.exampleZh: 他的老狗昨晚在花园里安静地死了。

dig.example: The dog likes to dig a hole in the garden every morning.
dig.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢每天早上在花园里挖一个洞。

dinner.example: We usually have dinner together at seven every evening after work.
dinner.exampleZh: 我们通常每天下班后七点一起吃晚餐。

dirty.example: My shoes are very dirty after I walked through the wet garden.
dirty.exampleZh: 我走过潮湿的花园后，鞋子很脏。

dish.example: She put the hot dish on the table and smiled at us.
dish.exampleZh: 她把热菜放在桌上，并对我们笑了笑。

do.example: I usually do my homework after dinner with my sister.
do.exampleZh: 我通常晚饭后和妹妹一起做作业。

doctor.example: The doctor looked at my throat and told me to rest at home.
doctor.exampleZh: 医生看了看我的喉咙，让我在家休息。

dog.example: The dog runs in the park and plays with a red ball.
dog.exampleZh: 那只狗在公园里跑，还玩一个红色的球。

doll.example: The little girl hugs her favorite doll and smiles at her mother.
doll.exampleZh: 小女孩抱着她最喜欢的洋娃娃，并对她妈妈微笑。

dollar.example: I only have one dollar in my pocket today.
dollar.exampleZh: 我今天口袋里只有一美元。

door.example: Please close the door when you leave the room.
door.exampleZh: 离开房间时请把门关上。

down.example: She walked down the stairs to the kitchen for breakfast.
down.exampleZh: 她走下楼梯到厨房吃早餐。

draw.example: I like to draw a big picture of my family on the wall.
draw.exampleZh: 我喜欢在墙上画一幅我家人的大画。

dream.example: I had a strange dream last night and woke up early.
dream.exampleZh: 昨晚我做了一个奇怪的梦，很早就醒了。

dress.example: She bought a new dress for the party last night.
dress.exampleZh: 她昨晚为聚会买了一条新连衣裙。

drink.example: I drink a glass of water every morning before I go to work.
drink.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前喝一杯水。

drive.example: I drive my car to work every day.

driver.example: The driver stopped the bus and helped an old woman get off.
driver.exampleZh: 司机停下公交车，并帮助一位老妇人下车。

drop.example: A drop of rain fell on my hand this morning.
drop.exampleZh: 今天早上，一滴雨落在了我的手上。

drum.example: He hit the drum loudly during the school music show.
drum.exampleZh: 他在学校音乐表演中大声敲鼓。

dry.example: Please dry your hands with this clean towel before you eat.
dry.exampleZh: 请在吃饭前用这条干净毛巾擦干你的手。

duck.example: I saw a yellow duck swimming in the pond this morning.
duck.exampleZh: 今天早上我看到一只黄色的鸭子在池塘里游泳。

dumpling.example: My mother makes dumplings every Sunday for the whole family.
dumpling.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天都为全家人包饺子。

during.example: I fell asleep during the movie and missed the ending.
during.exampleZh: 我在看电影时睡着了，错过了结尾。

each.example: Each student in our class has a small blue book on the desk.
each.exampleZh: 我们班每个学生的桌上都有一本蓝色的小书。

ear.example: My little sister often listens to music with one ear.
ear.exampleZh: 我妹妹经常用一只耳朵听音乐。

early.example: I usually get up early to catch the first bus.
early.exampleZh: 我通常早起去赶第一班公交车。

east.example: The sun rises in the east and brings light to the whole city.
east.exampleZh: 太阳从东方升起，给整座城市带来光明。

easy.example: This book is easy to read, so I can finish it quickly.
easy.exampleZh: 这本书很容易读，所以我能很快读完。

eat.example: I eat an apple every morning before I go to work.
eat.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前吃一个苹果。

egg.example: I eat one egg and some bread for breakfast every morning.
egg.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃一个鸡蛋和一些面包。

eight.example: There are eight apples in the basket on the kitchen table.
eight.exampleZh: 厨房桌子上的篮子里有八个苹果。

eighteen.example: My sister is eighteen years old and she studies at a small college.
eighteen.exampleZh: 我姐姐十八岁，在一所小型学院学习。

either.example: You can choose either of these two books.
either.exampleZh: 你可以选这两本书中的任意一本。

elephant.example: The elephant is very big and it drinks a lot of water.

eleven.example: There are eleven players on our school football team this year.
eleven.exampleZh: 今年我们学校足球队有十一名队员。

email.example: I will send you an email after I finish my work today.
email.exampleZh: 我今天完成工作后会给你发一封电子邮件。

empty.example: The bottle is empty, so please fill it with fresh water.
empty.exampleZh: 瓶子是空的，所以请往里面装些新鲜的水。

end.example: The meeting will end at five, so please come back before then.
end.exampleZh: 会议将在五点结束，所以请在那之前回来。

engineer.example: My father is an engineer and he works in a big city.
engineer.exampleZh: 我父亲是一名工程师，他在一个大城市工作。

english.example: I learn English at school every day because it is useful.
english.exampleZh: 我每天在学校学英语，因为它很有用。

enjoy.example: I really enjoy reading books with my friends on quiet weekend afternoons.
enjoy.exampleZh: 我很喜欢在安静的周末下午和朋友们一起读书。

enough.example: We have enough food and water for everyone in the group.
enough.exampleZh: 我们有足够的食物和水供小组里的每个人。

enter.example: Please knock on the door before you enter the meeting room.

eraser.example: Please borrow my eraser if you need to fix that mistake.
eraser.exampleZh: 如果你需要改正那个错误，请借我的橡皮。

evening.example: We often watch a movie at home in the evening.
evening.exampleZh: 我们经常在晚上在家看电影。

every.example: Every student in our class brings a notebook to school.
every.exampleZh: 我们班每个学生都带笔记本到学校。

example.example: My teacher gave us a clear example to help us understand the new lesson.
example.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一个清晰的例子，帮助我们理解新课。

excited.example: The children were very excited about their trip to the zoo.
excited.exampleZh: 孩子们对去动物园的旅行感到非常兴奋。

excuse.example: Please excuse me for being late to the meeting this morning.
excuse.exampleZh: 请原谅我今天早上开会迟到。

exit.example: Please walk to the exit on the left side of the hall.
exit.exampleZh: 请走到大厅左侧的出口。

eye.example: My left eye hurts a little when I read in bright light.
eye.exampleZh: 我在强光下看书时，左眼会有点疼。

face.example: She washed her face and smiled at the mirror before breakfast.
face.exampleZh: 她在早餐前洗脸并对着镜子微笑。

fact.example: It is a fact that the sun rises in the east.
fact.exampleZh: 太阳从东方升起是一个事实。

factory.example: My uncle works in a large factory near the river in our town.
factory.exampleZh: 我叔叔在我们镇上河边的一家大工厂工作。

fall.example: The leaves fall from the trees in autumn and cover the ground.
fall.exampleZh: 秋天，树叶从树上落下，覆盖了地面。

family.example: My family and I often eat dinner together at home on Sundays.
family.exampleZh: 我的家人和我经常在星期天在家一起吃晚饭。

famous.example: This city is famous for its beautiful parks and old buildings.
famous.exampleZh: 这座城市以其美丽的公园和古老的建筑而闻名。

fan.example: The fan in my room keeps me cool on hot summer days.
fan.exampleZh: 我房间里的风扇在炎热的夏日让我保持凉爽。

far.example: The school is too far for my little brother to walk.
far.exampleZh: 学校太远了，我弟弟没法走着去。

farm.example: My uncle lives on a small farm and grows vegetables every year.
farm.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在一个小农场里，每年都种蔬菜。

farmer.example: The farmer gets up early and works hard on his small farm.
farmer.exampleZh: 这位农民早起，在他的小农场上辛勤劳作。

fast.example: The fast train gets to the city in only twenty minutes.
fast.exampleZh: 这趟快车只要二十分钟就能到城里。

father.example: My father works in a small office near our home.
father.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们家附近的一间小办公室工作。

favorite.example: This is my favorite book to read before bed every night.
favorite.exampleZh: 这是我每晚睡前最喜欢读的书。

fear.example: Many people fear failure because it makes them feel small and alone.
fear.exampleZh: 许多人害怕失败，因为那会让他们觉得自己渺小又孤单。

february.example: We will visit our grandparents in February because the weather is usually cold.
february.exampleZh: 我们将在二月去看望祖父母，因为天气通常很冷。

feed.example: She will feed the chickens before she goes to work.

feel.example: I feel happy when I spend time with my good friends.
feel.exampleZh: 我和好朋友在一起时感到开心。

few.example: Few people came to the small meeting on Monday morning.
few.exampleZh: 星期一早上很少有人来参加那个小会议。

field.example: The farmer grows corn in the field behind his small house.
field.exampleZh: 农民在他小屋后面的田里种玉米。

fifteen.example: My sister is fifteen years old and she loves to play basketball with her friends.
fifteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十五岁，她喜欢和朋友们一起打篮球。

fight.example: The two boys began to fight over a toy in the park.
fight.exampleZh: 两个男孩在公园里因为一个玩具打了起来。

fill.example: Please fill the glass with water before you put it on the table.
fill.exampleZh: 请你在把杯子放到桌上之前，先把它装满水。

film.example: I watched a good film with my friends last weekend.
film.exampleZh: 上周末我和朋友们看了一部好电影。

find.example: I need to find my keys before we leave for work today.
find.exampleZh: 我今天需要在上班前找到我的钥匙。

fine.example: The weather is fine today so we can go for a walk in the park.
fine.exampleZh: 今天天气很好，所以我们可以去公园散步。

finger.example: She cut her finger while she was cooking dinner in the kitchen.
finger.exampleZh: 她在厨房做晚饭时切到了手指。

finish.example: I will finish my homework before I watch TV tonight.
finish.exampleZh: 我今晚会在看电视之前完成作业。

fire.example: We sat around the fire and sang songs late into the night.
fire.exampleZh: 我们围坐在火边，唱歌直到深夜。

first.example: This is the first time I have seen such a big dog.
first.exampleZh: 这是我第一次见到这么大的狗。

fish.example: We went to the lake to fish and caught three small fish.
fish.exampleZh: 我们去湖边钓鱼，抓到了三条小鱼。

fit.example: Regular exercise helps you stay fit and healthy every day.
fit.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能帮助你每天保持健康。

five.example: There are five apples on the table in the kitchen.
five.exampleZh: 厨房的桌子上有五个苹果。

fix.example: My father can fix the old bike in the garage.
fix.exampleZh: 我爸爸能在车库里修好那辆旧自行车。

flag.example: The red flag is flying high above the old school building today.
flag.exampleZh: 今天，那面红旗在旧校舍上方高高飘扬。

flat.example: The land near the river is very flat and good for farming.
flat.exampleZh: 河边的那块地很平坦，适合耕种。

flight.example: Our flight to Beijing was delayed by two hours because of heavy rain.
flight.exampleZh: 我们飞往北京的航班因大雨延误了两个小时。

floor.example: The children sat on the floor and played with their toys.
floor.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在地板上玩玩具。

flower.example: I gave my mother a beautiful flower from our small garden.
flower.exampleZh: 我把我们小花园里的一朵漂亮的花送给了妈妈。

fly.example: The children like to fly their new kite in the park on windy days.
fly.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在有风的日子去公园放他们的新风筝。

follow.example: The small dog likes to follow me around the garden every morning.
follow.exampleZh: 这只小狗喜欢每天早上跟着我在花园里转。

food.example: I bought some food for the picnic we will have tomorrow.
food.exampleZh: 我为我们明天要去的野餐买了一些食物。

foot.example: My left foot hurts after I walk for a long time.
foot.exampleZh: 我走了很久以后，左脚很疼。

football.example: My brother plays football with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
football.exampleZh: 我弟弟每个星期六下午都和朋友们踢足球。

for.example: I bought a small gift for my mother on her birthday.
for.exampleZh: 我在妈妈生日那天给她买了一份小礼物。

force.example: The strong wind can force us to stay inside all day.
force.exampleZh: 强风会迫使我们整天待在室内。

foreign.example: She wants to learn a foreign language before she travels to Europe next year.
foreign.exampleZh: 她想在明年去欧洲旅行之前学一门外语。

forget.example: I always forget where I put my keys in the morning.
forget.exampleZh: 我早上总是忘记把钥匙放在哪里了。

fork.example: Please put a fork and a knife next to my plate.
fork.exampleZh: 请把一把叉子和一把刀放在我的盘子旁边。

form.example: Please fill out this form before you see the doctor today.
form.exampleZh: 请在你今天看医生之前填好这张表格。

forty.example: My father is forty years old and works in a small shop.
forty.exampleZh: 我父亲四十岁，在一家小商店工作。

four.example: My sister has four small cats and two big dogs at home.
four.exampleZh: 我妹妹家里有四只小猫和两只大狗。

fourteen.example: My sister is fourteen years old and she loves to play basketball.
fourteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十四岁，她喜欢打篮球。

fox.example: The quick red fox ran across the field and disappeared into the woods.
fox.exampleZh: 那只敏捷的红狐狸跑过田野，消失在树林里。

free.example: The museum is free for children on every Sunday morning.
free.exampleZh: 博物馆每周日早上对儿童免费。

fresh.example: I bought some fresh fruit and vegetables at the market this morning.
fresh.exampleZh: 今天早上我在市场买了一些新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

friday.example: We will meet at the library on Friday to study for our exam.
friday.exampleZh: 我们星期五将在图书馆见面，为考试复习。

fridge.example: We put the milk and eggs in the fridge after we get home.
fridge.exampleZh: 我们回到家后把牛奶和鸡蛋放进冰箱。

friend.example: I met a new friend at school today and we played together.
friend.exampleZh: 我今天在学校认识了一个新朋友，我们一起玩了。

friendly.example: Our new neighbor is very friendly and often says hello to everyone.
friendly.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居非常友好，经常向每个人打招呼。

from.example: I got this nice book from my best friend yesterday.
from.exampleZh: 我昨天从最好的朋友那里得到了这本好书。

front.example: Please wait for me in front of the school gate after class.
front.exampleZh: 请下课后在学校大门前面等我。

fruit.example: I eat fresh fruit every morning because it is good for my health.
fruit.exampleZh: 我每天早上都吃新鲜水果，因为这对我的健康有好处。

full.example: The small bottle is full of clean water from the well.
full.exampleZh: 这个小瓶子装满了来自井里的干净水。

fun.example: We had a lot of fun at the park yesterday.
fun.exampleZh: 昨天我们在公园里玩得很开心。

funny.example: The funny movie made all of us laugh for a long time.
funny.exampleZh: 那部有趣的电影让我们笑了很久。

future.example: I believe the future will be bright for all of us.
future.exampleZh: 我相信我们所有人的未来都会很光明。

game.example: We played a fun game after school with our friends yesterday.
game.exampleZh: 昨天放学后我们和朋友们玩了一个有趣的游戏。

garden.example: My grandmother grows many beautiful flowers in her small garden every spring.
garden.exampleZh: 我祖母每年春天在她的小花园里种许多美丽的花。

gas.example: The car needs gas before we start our long trip.
gas.exampleZh: 在我们开始长途旅行之前，这辆车需要加油。

get.example: I need to get some milk and bread from the store today.
get.exampleZh: 我今天需要从商店买些牛奶和面包。

gift.example: I bought a small gift for my mother on her birthday.
gift.exampleZh: 我在妈妈生日那天给她买了一份小礼物。

giraffe.example: The tall giraffe ate leaves from a tree in the zoo.
giraffe.exampleZh: 那只高高的长颈鹿在动物园里吃树上的叶子。

girl.example: The little girl is playing with her friends in the park.
girl.exampleZh: 那个小女孩正在公园里和朋友们玩耍。

give.example: Please give me a glass of water before we leave the house.
give.exampleZh: 在我们离开房子之前，请给我一杯水。

glad.example: I am very glad to see you again today.
glad.exampleZh: 今天再次见到你，我非常高兴。

glass.example: Please put the glass on the table before you leave.
glass.exampleZh: 请在你离开前把杯子放在桌子上。

glove.example: I found one glove on the bench after the game.
glove.exampleZh: 比赛结束后，我在长椅上找到了一只手套。

go.example: I want to go to the park with my friends this afternoon.
go.exampleZh: 今天下午我想和朋友们去公园。

goal.example: My main goal this year is to read more books.
goal.exampleZh: 我今年的主要目标是读更多的书。

goat.example: The old farmer keeps a white goat and two small chickens on his farm.
goat.exampleZh: 那位老农在农场里养了一只白山羊和两只小鸡。

god.example: Many people pray to God when they feel afraid or alone.
god.exampleZh: 许多人在感到害怕或孤独时向上帝祈祷。

gold.example: She wore a beautiful gold dress to the party last night.
gold.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条漂亮的金色连衣裙去参加聚会。

good.example: This is a good book for children to read at home.
good.exampleZh: 这是一本适合孩子在家阅读的好书。

goodbye.example: She waved and said goodbye to her friends before the train left.
goodbye.exampleZh: 她在火车离开前向朋友们挥手道别。

goose.example: The goose swims across the pond with her little yellow babies.
goose.exampleZh: 那只鹅带着她的黄色小宝宝游过池塘。

grade.example: My sister is in the fifth grade at a small local school.
grade.exampleZh: 我妹妹在当地一所小学校上五年级。

grandfather.example: My grandfather tells me interesting stories about his childhood every Sunday afternoon.
grandfather.exampleZh: 我祖父每个星期天下午都会给我讲他童年有趣的故事。

grandmother.example: My grandmother makes delicious cookies for us every Sunday afternoon.
grandmother.exampleZh: 我祖母每个星期天下午都给我们做美味的饼干。

grape.example: My mother bought a bunch of grapes at the market this morning.
grape.exampleZh: 我妈妈今天早上在市场买了一串葡萄。

grass.example: The children like to play on the green grass in the park.
grass.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园的绿草地上玩耍。

great.example: She had a great time at the party with her friends.
great.exampleZh: 她和朋友们在聚会上玩得很开心。

green.example: The leaves on the tree turn green in the warm spring sun.
green.exampleZh: 在温暖的春日阳光下，树上的叶子变绿了。

ground.example: The children fell to the ground while playing in the yard.
ground.exampleZh: 孩子们在院子里玩耍时摔倒在地。

group.example: A small group of students is waiting outside the school gate.
group.exampleZh: 一小群学生正在学校门外等候。

grow.example: Farmers grow rice and vegetables in the fields every year.
grow.exampleZh: 农民每年在田里种植水稻和蔬菜。

guess.example: Can you guess what I have in my hand right now?
guess.exampleZh: 你能猜到我现在手里拿着什么吗？

guest.example: Our guest will arrive at six, so please clean the living room.
guest.exampleZh: 我们的客人六点到，请打扫一下客厅。

guitar.example: My brother plays the guitar every evening after he finishes his homework.
guitar.exampleZh: 我哥哥每天晚上做完作业后弹吉他。

hair.example: Her hair is long and black, and she often ties it back.
hair.exampleZh: 她的头发又长又黑，她经常把它扎起来。

half.example: Half of the students in our class walk to school every morning.
half.exampleZh: 我们班一半的学生每天早上步行上学。

hall.example: The guests waited in the hall before the dinner began.
hall.exampleZh: 客人们在晚餐开始前在大厅里等候。

ham.example: I put some ham and cheese on my bread for lunch today.
ham.exampleZh: 我今天午餐在面包上放了一些火腿和奶酪。

hamburger.example: I bought a hamburger and some fries for lunch today.
hamburger.exampleZh: 我今天午餐买了一个汉堡包和一些薯条。

hand.example: She held my hand as we walked slowly through the quiet park.
hand.exampleZh: 我们慢慢穿过安静的公园时，她牵着我的手。

handsome.example: The handsome young man smiled and thanked everyone for their kind help.
handsome.exampleZh: 那位英俊的年轻人微笑着感谢大家的善意帮助。

hang.example: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door before you come in.

wrong.exampleZh: 我认为你今天打错这个办公室的电话号码了。

x-ray.example: The doctor used an x-ray to see the broken bone in his arm.
x-ray.exampleZh: 医生用X光查看他手臂上断裂的骨头。

xerox.example: Please xerox these two pages and put them on my desk.
xerox.exampleZh: 请复印这两页，并把它们放在我的桌子上。

yard.example: The children are playing a fun game in the back yard today.
yard.exampleZh: 孩子们今天在后院玩一个有趣的游戏。

year.example: I will visit my grandparents in China next year.
year.exampleZh: 明年我将去中国看望我的祖父母。

yellow.example: She wore a bright yellow dress to the party last night.
yellow.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条鲜艳的黄色连衣裙去参加聚会。

yes.example: Yes, I would like to go to the park with you today.
yes.exampleZh: 是的，我今天想和你一起去公园。

yesterday.example: I saw my old friend at the park yesterday afternoon.
yesterday.exampleZh: 昨天下午我在公园里见到了我的老朋友。

yet.example: I have not finished my homework yet, so I cannot go out.
yet.exampleZh: 我还没有完成作业，所以不能出去。

you.example: You can bring your favorite book to school and read it with your friends.
you.exampleZh: 你可以带你最喜欢的书去学校，和朋友们一起读。

young.example: My young brother likes to play football with his friends after school.
young.exampleZh: 我年轻的弟弟喜欢放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

your.example: Please put your books on the desk before you leave the room.
your.exampleZh: 请在你离开房间前把你的书放在桌子上。

yours.example: This book is yours, and that blue pen on the desk is mine too.
yours.exampleZh: 这本书是你的，桌上那支蓝色钢笔也是我的。

yourself.example: You should take care of yourself when you are tired and need rest.
yourself.exampleZh: 当你累了需要休息时，你应该照顾好自己。

zebra.example: I saw a zebra at the zoo and it had black and white stripes.
zebra.exampleZh: 我在动物园看到一只斑马，它有黑白相间的条纹。

zero.example: The temperature dropped to zero last night and the water froze.
zero.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到零度，水结了冰。

zoo.example: We took the children to the zoo and saw many animals.
zoo.exampleZh: 我们带孩子们去动物园，看到了许多动物。
